notes.title: I Released a New Game!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hello, I have been working on a new game for a year or so now and I am now releasing it. [b]StreetSync:[/b]  About: Dive into a rhythm-action FPS rogue-like where every shot must sync with the beat. Slide, wall-run, and harness the rhythm using your own custom music. One missed note leads to your demise. Collect powerful cards to remix the gameplay and keep the beat alive![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/WEW2H-h_Iks?si=Ez0mzUVlVoXI8OgC"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] Steam page link: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108670/StreetSync/?beta=1"]Save 40% on StreetSync on Steam[/url][/p][p]I hope you give the game a try thank you guys![/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Changes!
notes.content:
Changes:
- you are able to see where the enemies are at all times now besides inside of any Expert level.
- The difficulty of Expert level on every map has been made easier. 
- On Funtime the Rollercoaster ride has been speed up.
Fixes:
- On Funtime you would sometimes get stuck on the rollercoaster ride at the end. 
- On Scare Fields the boss Attack speed has been Slown down on Expert.

P.S - Please give your suggestions of other things you guys think need changes to the game and if you guys like the new changes.

notes.title: I am working on a New Game!
notes.content:
Hello 
I have been working on a new game for a month or so now and I am now showing it off. 

What comes with Room 13:

- an endless hotel with spot the difference gameplay
- 7 different shaders  
- 30 anomalies 
-Realistic art style 

About:
You are inside an endless hotel but there is a way you can escape. Search in the hallways of the hotel and find the changes within them to reach Room 13.
If you find anomalies, turn around!
If you think the room is normal continue to the exit.
To get to Room 13.
Room 13 is a small walking simulator inspired by the backrooms and liminal spaces.

[previewyoutube=z7D5o4N-Nsw;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam page link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2785850/Room_13/



What does it mean for Chapter 3 Of The Paper Trials?

this game isn't going to change any of the plans for the game and I just needed a different project to take a break from developing that.
I Have started the development of Chapter 3, and it is still months away from release.

notes.title: performance fixes
notes.content:
Fixes 
- Performance has almost doubled what it was in the last update

- bug with amd users having flickering textures is fixed

Thank you to everyone who has been giving feedback and I will try to get to all of the issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Chapter 2 Release Window
notes.content:
Hello,
I'm so thankful for everybody that has been playing the game and enjoying it.
Chapter 2 has been taking a lot longer than expected to complete and I'm sorry for that I am currently in college and trying to get Chapter 2 done in my free time.

 Current state of Chapter 2 - 
I have Scare fields fully completed and am in the final stages of creating the Fun Time level and moving on to creating the boss of Fun Time. Overall, I have Chapter 2 mostly finished I just need time to make sure it's a polished finished release.

 Window for Release - 
I am planning on releasing Chapter 2 within the range of December - January.
This is not a fully set date and subject to change.

 Price -
1.99$

Thank you all again for your support on The Paper Trials and I hope to get you guys new content to play soon!
